name: edge-items-not-run
title: Edge case: loop items that do not run
description: An edge-case fixture (#1508, comment 6 item 3; comment 7 Q4): the loop problem_loop has max 2, so a third problem does not run. The deliverable note, composed from the loop, writes a heading for each item that ran; the deliverable problem_list reads the rendered node problem_lines, whose template writes a fixed line for each item of the loop, naming its problem. Fictional; not intended for clinical use.
